tools.name: booking_check
tools.description: Parse booking/confirmation documents (emails, receipts) and return reconciled booking-state verdicts: confirmed/held/pending/cancelled/unknown, each with a citable proof packet. CONFIRMED is returned only on supplier-authoritative evidence; anything weaker returns UNKNOWN plus the indicated state. S
